purpose: Development smoke benchmark; not held-out evidence for resume claims

metric_definitions.document_recall_at: Fraction of annotated relevant source documents present in the first k returned contexts; only for cases with source labels
metric_definitions.document_mrr_at_5: Mean reciprocal rank of the first annotated relevant source in the first five contexts
metric_definitions.citation_source_precision_when_cited: Fraction of cited source IDs matching document labels, conditional on a cited answer; NOT per-claim entailment
metric_definitions.evidence_phrase_recall: Mean fraction of gold phrases present in retrieved context for answerable questions; NOT document Recall@k
metric_definitions.answer_phrase_coverage: Mean fraction of gold phrases in answer text; NOT factual correctness
metric_definitions.unanswerable_abstention_rate: Fraction of labelled unanswerable questions returning insufficient evidence
metric_definitions.latency: Local request wall time; model warmup not separated; small sample, not a load test. Token usage excludes cache priming requests.
